    local dot = d.x * g.x + d.y * g.y + d.z * g.z
    if dot > 1 then
        dot = 1
    elseif dot < -1 then
        dot = -1
    end
    return math.deg(math.acos(dot))
end

local function ResolveMeteorDummyOrigin(origin, pos)
    if not origin or not pos then
        return nil
    end
    local dy = pos.y - origin.y
    if dy <= 0 then
        return nil
    end
    local max_dx = math.tan(math.rad(METEOR_MAX_ANGLE_DEG)) * dy
    local min_x = pos.x - max_dx
    local max_x = pos.x + max_dx
    local new_x = Clamp(origin.x, min_x, max_x)
    return Vector(new_x, origin.y, origin.z)
end

local function UpdateMeteorDummySp(context, profile, pos)
    if not profile then
        return
    end
    profile.force_dummy_sp = nil
    profile.force_dummy_sp_origin = nil
    profile.force_dummy_sp_sync_gesture = nil
    if not context or not context.parent or context.parent:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    if not pos then
        return
    end
    local origin = context.parent:GetAbsOrigin()
    local angle = AngleToGoodForward(origin, pos)
    if not angle or angle <= METEOR_MAX_ANGLE_DEG then
        return
    end
    profile.force_dummy_sp = true
    profile.force_dummy_sp_origin = ResolveMeteorDummyOrigin(origin, pos) or origin
    profile.force_dummy_sp_sync_gesture = true
end

local function EnsureAbility(unit, name, level)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    local ab = unit:FindAbilityByName(name)
    if not ab then
        ab = unit:AddAbility(name)
    end
    if ab and level and level > 0 then
        ab:SetLevel(level)
        ab:SetActivated(true)
    end
    return ab
end

local function GetInvokerLevels(dummy_level)
    if not dummy_level or dummy_level <= 0 then
        return INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS[1]
    end
    return INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS[dummy_level] or INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS[#INVOKER_ORB_LEVELS]
end

local function ParseCombo(combo)
    if type(combo) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end
    local counts = { quas = 0, wex = 0, exort = 0 }
    for orb in string.gmatch(combo, "%S+") do
        if counts[orb] ~= nil then
            counts[orb] = counts[orb] + 1
        end
    end
    return counts
end

local function AddToSlots(state, name)
    if not state or not name then
        return
    end
    for _, slot in ipairs(state.slots) do
        if slot == name then
            return
        end
    end
    table.insert(state.slots, name)
    if #state.slots > 2 then
        table.remove(state.slots, 1)
    end
end

local function GetInvokerUnits(context)
    local units = {}
    if not context then
        return units
    end
    if context.parent and not context.parent:IsNull() then
        table.insert(units, context.parent)
        local visuals = context.parent.__shop1_visual_dummies
        if visuals then
            for _, v in ipairs(visuals) do
                if v and not v:IsNull() then
                    table.insert(units, v)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return units
end

local function EnsureOrbsAndInvoke(context, unit)
    if not context then
        return nil, nil, nil, nil
    end

    local target = unit or context.parent
    if not target or target:IsNull() then
        return nil, nil, nil, nil
    end

    local levels = GetInvokerLevels(context.dummy_level)
    context.special_state = context.special_state or {}
    context.special_state.invoker = context.special_state.invoker or { slots = {} }

    local quas = EnsureAbility(target, "invoker_quas", levels.quas or 1)
    local wex = EnsureAbility(target, "invoker_wex", levels.wex or 1)
    local exort = EnsureAbility(target, "invoker_exort", levels.exort or 1)
    local invoke = EnsureAbility(target, "invoker_invoke", 1)

    if (not quas) or (not wex) or (not exort) or (not invoke) then
        print(string.format(
            "[InvokerHandler][EnsureOrbs] missing ability (quas=%s,wex=%s,exort=%s,invoke=%s) dummy=%s lvl=%s",
            tostring(quas), tostring(wex), tostring(exort), tostring(invoke),
            tostring(target and target:GetUnitName() or "nil"),
            tostring(context.dummy_level)
        ))
        return nil, nil, nil, nil
    end

    return quas, wex, exort, invoke
end

local InvokerHandler = {}

function InvokerHandler:Init(context)
    if not context or not context.parent or context.parent:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    EnsureOrbsAndInvoke(context)
end

function InvokerHandler:PrepareCast(context, profile, enemy, pos)
    if not context or not context.parent or context.parent:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if not context.parent:IsAlive() then
        return false
    end
    if not profile or profile.is_attack then
        return false
    end
    profile.invoker_queue_cast = nil
    if profile.projectile_name == "invoker_chaos_meteor" then
        profile.force_dummy_sp = nil
        profile.force_dummy_sp_origin = nil
        profile.force_dummy_sp_sync_gesture = nil
        UpdateMeteorDummySp(context, profile, pos)
        ApplyMeteorOverrides(context, profile, context.parent)
    end

    local combo = ParseCombo(INVOKER_COMBOS[profile.projectile_name])
    if not combo then
        return false
    end

    local quas, wex, exort, invoke = EnsureOrbsAndInvoke(context)

    if not quas or not wex or not exort or not invoke then
        return false
    end

    local state = context.special_state and context.special_state.invoker
    if state and state.slots then
        for _, slot in ipairs(state.slots) do
            if slot == profile.projectile_name then
                return false
            end
        end
    end

    local function QueueOrb(unit, orb, count)
        if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
            return
        end
        if not orb or count <= 0 then
            return
        end
        for _ = 1, count do
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = unit:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = orb:entindex(),
                Queue = true,
            })
        end
    end

    local units = GetInvokerUnits(context)
    for _, unit in ipairs(units) do
        local uq, uw, ue, uinvoke = quas, wex, exort, invoke
        if unit ~= context.parent then
            uq, uw, ue, uinvoke = EnsureOrbsAndInvoke(context, unit)
        end
        if uq and uw and ue then
            QueueOrb(unit, uq, combo.quas or 0)
            QueueOrb(unit, uw, combo.wex or 0)
            QueueOrb(unit, ue, combo.exort or 0)
        end

        if uinvoke then
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = unit:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = uinvoke:entindex(),
                Queue = true,
            })
        end
    end

    if state then
        AddToSlots(state, profile.projectile_name)
    end
    profile.invoker_queue_cast = true

    return true
end

function InvokerHandler:TakeoverCast(context, profile, enemy, pos, caster, ability, order_type)
    if not profile or profile.is_attack then
        return false
    end
    if not profile.invoker_queue_cast then
        return false
    end
    profile.invoker_queue_cast = nil
    if not caster or caster:IsNull() or not ability or ability:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if profile.projectile_name == "invoker_chaos_meteor" then
        ApplyMeteorOverrides(context, profile, caster)
    end

    local order = {
        UnitIndex = caster:entindex(),
        OrderType = order_type,
        AbilityIndex = ability:entindex(),
        Queue = true,
    }
    if order_type == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET then
        if not enemy or enemy:IsNull() then
            return false
        end
        order.TargetIndex = enemy:entindex()
    elseif order_type == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION then
        if not pos then
            return false
        end
        order.Position = pos
    end

    ExecuteOrderFromTable(order)
    return true
end

function InvokerHandler:OnAbilityAdded(context, profile, ability)
    if not profile or profile.is_attack then
        return
    end
    if profile.projectile_name ~= "invoker_chaos_meteor" then
        return
    end
    ApplyMeteorOverrides(context, profile, ability and ability:GetCaster())
    profile.search_angle_limit_deg = METEOR_SEARCH_ANGLE_DEG
end

return InvokerHandler

**Analyzing missing target points in cast event**

The `params.target_points` is nil in `OnAbilityFullyCast`, likely because this event doesn't always provide target points, especially for unit-targeted spells. Using `ability:GetCursorPosition()` at cast time might retrieve the correct position without patching, but the root cause may relate to how the cast is triggered or queued in interacting modifiers or abilities.

**Examining queued cast position missing due to behavior mismatch**

The nil `target_points` may stem from casting with `Queue=true` on a dummy caster where the ability's behavior or order type mismatches expected point targeting—possibly the ability is sometimes treated as target or no-target rather than position. Confirming behavior in the dummy autocast profile and related configs will clarify if incorrect behavior settings cause missing position data without patching.

- 在 `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/projectiles/autocast_specials/invoker.lua` 的 `TakeoverCast` 里，点施法时明确 `caster:SetCursorPosition(pos)` 并 `FaceTowards(pos)`，保证引擎生成 `target_points`。
- 同时移除了之前的 `__last_cast_pos` 记录与 fallback（你要求不要打补丁）。

修改的文件：
- `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/projectiles/autocast_specials/invoker.lua`
- `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/abilities/enhance/invoker_chaos_meteor.lua`
- `game/dzsj/scripts/vscripts/projectiles/modifier_dummy_autocast.lua`

如果仍出现，我会继续向上追到 `ExecuteOrderFromTable` 的调用栈并替换为 `CastAbilityOnPosition`（确保引擎一定写入 `target_points`）。

**Tracing missing target points**

The invoker chaos meteor ability seems cast by a dummy_sp using queued orders, causing OnAbilityFullyCast to receive no target_points; likely because dummy_sp casts via ExecuteOrderFromTable with SetCursorPosition but OnAbilityFullyCast’s params lack target_points for queued orders or dummy-sp-owned casts. **Analyzing missing target_points in ability cast events**

The OnAbilityFullyCast event lacks target_points despite using CastAbilityOnPosition, likely because the ability instance triggering the event is not the actual cast or is from a dummy unit with special cast flags. This suggests the root fix should fallback to retrieving the cursor position directly from the ability when target_points are missing for point-targeted abilities.

**Identifying root cause of missing target_points**

The missing target_points in OnAbilityFullyCast stem from engine behavior where this event doesn’t include target positions for queued casts by dummy units, especially with AI-controlled or autocast abilities. The reliable fix is to capture target_points in the earlier OnAbilityExecuted event, which always includes them, and then reference that data during OnAbilityFullyCast to ensure position availability without relying on incomplete event params.

现在再跑日志，如果还出现 `no_pos`，那说明 `OnAbilityExecuted` 也没拿到目标点，我们再继续往上查事件来源（可能需要改为 `OnAbilityPhaseStart`）。

如果你希望我同时把 `OnAbilityExecuted` 的 entindex 打出来用于对比，我可以加一个仅 DEBUG 的 log。

**Planning explicit point passing**

I'm considering storing the cast position explicitly on the ability or caster during invoker's cast initiation to pass the target point deterministically, since existing events lack target_points and dummy units cause playerID issues. This approach avoids deep patching by adding a stored position read later in the invoked ability.

**Evaluating skipping fall for sub meteor**

The sub meteor needs to bypass the falling phase and start rolling from impact, likely requiring setting its land_time to zero or spawning a rolling projectile directly; inspecting the base invoker_chaos_meteor ability and creating a manual projectile effect for the sub cast are the next steps.

**Planning per-cast land_time override for sub meteor**

To make the sub meteor skip falling and start rolling immediately, I'll extend the existing override modifier to include land_time and adjust invoker_chaos_meteor.lua to set land_time to 0 just before sub casts, then restore it after; this targets only sub meteors without affecting the main cast and aligns with the requirement to bypass the fall phase.

local enhance_common = require("abilities.enhance.enhance_common")

LinkLuaModifier("modifier_invoker_chaos_meteor_enhance",
    "abilities/enhance/invoker_chaos_meteor.lua", LUA_MODIFIER_MOTION_NONE)

local FIREBALL_PARTICLE = "particles/units/heroes/hero_jakiro/jakiro_base_attack_fire.vpcf"
local FIREBALL_IMPACT_PARTICLE = "particles/units/heroes/hero_invoker/invoker_base_attack_explosion_b.vpcf"
local FIRE_FIELD_PARTICLE = "particles/units/heroes/hero_dragon_knight/dragon_knight_shard_fireball_lava_a.vpcf"
local DEBUG_ENHANCE = true

local function ParsePercent(raw)
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" then
        return raw
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    local num = string.match(s, "^([%-]?%d+%.?%d*)%%%s*$")
    if num then
        return tonumber(num)
    end
    return tonumber(s)
end

local function GetPassiveAbility(caster, name)
    if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    local ab = caster:FindAbilityByName(name)
    if (not ab or ab:IsNull()) and caster.__autocast_source_dummy then
        local source = EntIndexToHScript(caster.__autocast_source_dummy)
        if source and not source:IsNull() then
            ab = source:FindAbilityByName(name)
        end
    end
    if not ab or ab:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    return ab
end

local function LogEnhancePassives(caster, used)
    if not DEBUG_ENHANCE then
        return
    end
    if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    local names = {
        "invoker_chaos_meteor_combo",
        "invoker_chaos_meteor_volley",
        "invoker_chaos_meteor_fireball",
        "invoker_chaos_meteor_fireball_combo",
        "invoker_chaos_meteor_fireball_damage",
        "invoker_chaos_meteor_fireball_damage_range",
        "invoker_chaos_meteor_fire",
        "invoker_chaos_meteor_sub",
    }
    local have = {}
    for _, name in ipairs(names) do
        local ab = GetPassiveAbility(caster, name)
        if ab and not ab:IsNull() then
            table.insert(have, string.format("%s:%s", name, tostring(ab:GetLevel())))
        end
    end
    print(string.format(
        "[MeteorEnhance] caster=%s ent=%s passives=%s used=%s",
        tostring(caster:GetUnitName()),
        tostring(caster:entindex()),
        table.concat(have, ","),
        tostring(used)
    ))
end

local function GetPassiveNumber(caster, name, key, fallback)

    if not ab then
        return fallback
    end
    local raw = enhance_common.GetPassiveRawValue(ab, key)
    local num = ParsePercent(raw)
    if num == nil then
        return fallback
    end
    return num
end

local function ResolveProfile(caster, ability_name)
    if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    local mod = caster:FindModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
    if mod and mod.GetProfileForAbilityName then
        return mod:GetProfileForAbilityName(ability_name)
    end
    return nil
end

local function SetMeteorLandTimeOverride(caster, value)
    if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    local mod = caster:FindModifierByName("modifier_invoker_meteor_autocast_override")
    if mod and mod.UpdateOverrides then
        mod:UpdateOverrides({ land_time = value })
    end
end

local function SelectTargetsAround(owner, center, range, count, avoid)
    if not owner or owner:IsNull() then
        return {}
    end
    local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
        owner:GetTeamNumber(),
        center,
        nil,
        range,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
        FIND_ANY_ORDER,
        false
    )
    local targets = {}
    if not enemies then
        return targets
    end
    for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies) do
        if enemy and not enemy:IsNull() and enemy ~= avoid then
            table.insert(targets, enemy)
            if #targets >= count then
                break
            end
        end
    end
    return targets
end

local function RotateDirection2D(dir, degrees)
    if not dir then
        return Vector(1, 0, 0)
    end
    local angle = math.rad(degrees or 0)
    local cosv = math.cos(angle)
    local sinv = math.sin(angle)
    return Vector(dir.x * cosv - dir.y * sinv, dir.x * sinv + dir.y * cosv, 0)
end

local function LaunchFireball(ability, owner, target, data)
    if not target or target:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    local info = {
        Target = target,
        Source = owner,
        Ability = ability,
        EffectName = FIREBALL_PARTICLE,
        iMoveSpeed = data.speed or 900,
        bDodgeable = true,
        bIsAttack = false,
        vSourceLoc = data.source_pos,
        ExtraData = data,
    }
    ProjectileManager:CreateTrackingProjectile(info)
end

local function ApplyFireField(owner, ability, pos, config)
    if not owner or owner:IsNull() or not pos then
        return
    end
    if FIRE_FIELD_PARTICLE and FIRE_FIELD_PARTICLE ~= "" then
        local fx = ParticleManager:CreateParticle(FIRE_FIELD_PARTICLE, PATTACH_WORLDORIGIN, nil)
        ParticleManager:SetParticleControl(fx, 0, pos)
        ParticleManager:ReleaseParticleIndex(fx)
    end
    local duration = config.duration or 0
    local interval = config.interval or 1
    local radius = config.radius or 0
    local base_damage = config.base_damage or 0
    local damage_scale = config.damage_scale or 1
    local elapsed = 0

    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
        if elapsed > duration then
            return nil
        end
        local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
            owner:GetTeamNumber(),
            pos,
            nil,
            radius,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
            DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
            FIND_ANY_ORDER,
            false
        )
        for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies) do
            if enemy and not enemy:IsNull() then
                enhance_common.ApplyProjectileDamage(owner, enemy, {
                    base_damage = base_damage,
                    damage_scale = damage_scale,
                    pure_percent = config.pure_percent or 0,
                    ability = ability,
                })
            end
        end
        elapsed = elapsed + interval
        return interval
    end)
end

local function FormatAbilityEventParams(params)
    if not params then
        return "nil"
    end
    local tp = params.target_points
    local tp_info = "nil"
    if type(tp) == "table" then
        local p = tp[1]
        if p then
            tp_info = string.format("%s(%.1f,%.1f)", tostring(#tp), p.x or 0, p.y or 0)
        else
            tp_info = tostring(#tp)
        end
    end
    return string.format(
        "unit=%s ent=%s ability=%s ab_ent=%s target=%s target_ent=%s target_points=%s",
        tostring(params.unit and params.unit.GetUnitName and params.unit:GetUnitName() or "nil"),
        tostring(params.unit and params.unit.entindex and params.unit:entindex() or "nil"),
        tostring(params.ability and params.ability.GetAbilityName and params.ability:GetAbilityName() or "nil"),
        tostring(params.ability and params.ability.entindex and params.ability:entindex() or "nil"),
        tostring(params.target and params.target.GetUnitName and params.target:GetUnitName() or "nil"),
        tostring(params.target and params.target.entindex and params.target:entindex() or "nil"),
        tp_info
    )
end

function modifier_invoker_chaos_meteor_enhance:OnAbilityExecuted(params)
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not params or not params.ability then
        return
    end
    local ability = params.ability
    if ability:GetAbilityName() ~= "invoker_chaos_meteor" then
        return
    end

    if DEBUG_ENHANCE then
        print(string.format("[MeteorEnhance][Executed] %s", FormatAbilityEventParams(params)))
    end

    local caster = params.unit or ability:GetCaster()
    local parent = self:GetParent()
    if not parent or parent:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    if caster ~= parent then
        local source = caster and caster.__autocast_source_dummy and EntIndexToHScript(caster.__autocast_source_dummy)
        if not source or source ~= parent then
            return
        end
    end
    local pos = nil
    if params.target_points and params.target_points[1] then
        pos = params.target_points[1]
    elseif params.target and not params.target:IsNull() then
        pos = params.target:GetAbsOrigin()
    end
    if not pos then
        return
    end
    ability.__enhance_last_cast_pos = pos
    ability.__enhance_last_cast_time = GameRules:GetGameTime()
    ability.__enhance_last_cast_caster = caster:entindex()
end

function modifier_invoker_chaos_meteor_enhance:OnAbilityFullyCast(params)
    if not IsServer() then return end

    if not self.is_controller then
        local parent = self:GetParent()
        if parent and not parent:IsNull() and not parent.__invoker_meteor_enhance_controller then
            parent.__invoker_meteor_enhance_controller = self
            self.is_controller = true
        else
            return
        end
    end
    if not params or not params.ability then
        return
    end
    local ability = params.ability
    if ability:GetAbilityName() ~= "invoker_chaos_meteor" then
        return
    end

    if DEBUG_ENHANCE then
        print(string.format("[MeteorEnhance][FullyCast] %s", FormatAbilityEventParams(params)))
    end
    
    local caster = params.unit or ability:GetCaster()
    local parent = self:GetParent()
    local use_source_dummy = false
    if caster ~= parent then
        local source = caster and caster.__autocast_source_dummy and EntIndexToHScript(caster.__autocast_source_dummy)
        if source and source == parent then
            use_source_dummy = true
        else
            if DEBUG_ENHANCE then
                print(string.format(
                    "[MeteorEnhance] cast_mismatch parent=%s ent=%s caster=%s ent=%s",
                    tostring(parent and parent:GetUnitName() or "nil"),
                    tostring(parent and parent:entindex() or "nil"),
                    tostring(caster and caster:GetUnitName() or "nil"),
                    tostring(caster and caster:entindex() or "nil")
                ))
            end
            return
        end
    end
    if DEBUG_ENHANCE then
        print(string.format(
            "[MeteorEnhance] cast unit=%s ent=%s ability=%s ab_ent=%s parent_ent=%s source_dummy=%s",
            tostring(caster and caster:GetUnitName() or "nil"),
            tostring(caster and caster:entindex() or "nil"),
            tostring(ability:GetAbilityName()),
            tostring(ability and ability:entindex() or "nil"),
            tostring(parent and parent:entindex() or "nil"),
            tostring(use_source_dummy)
        ))
    end
    local skip_extras = false
    if ability.__enhance_skip and ability.__enhance_skip > 0 then
        skip_extras = true
        if DEBUG_ENHANCE then
            print(string.format(
                "[MeteorEnhance] skip reason=enhance_skip left=%s ent=%s",
                tostring(ability.__enhance_skip),
                tostring(ability:entindex())
            ))
        end
        ability.__enhance_skip = ability.__enhance_skip - 1
    end

    local pos = nil
    if params.target_points and params.target_points[1] then
        pos = params.target_points[1]
    elseif params.target and not params.target:IsNull() then
        pos = params.target:GetAbsOrigin()
    end
    if not pos and ability.__enhance_last_cast_pos and ability.__enhance_last_cast_caster == caster:entindex() then
        pos = ability.__enhance_last_cast_pos
    end
    if not pos then
        if DEBUG_ENHANCE then
            print(string.format(
                "[MeteorEnhance] skip reason=no_pos target_points=%s target=%s",
                tostring(params.target_points and params.target_points[1] ~= nil),
                tostring(params.target and not params.target:IsNull())
            ))
        end
        return
    end

    local owner = enhance_common.ResolveOwner(caster) or caster
    local profile = ResolveProfile(caster, ability:GetAbilityName())
    local range = (profile and profile.range) or ability:GetCastRange(pos, nil) or 1200

    local extra_combo = GetPassiveNumber(caster, "invoker_chaos_meteor_combo", "count", 0) or 0
    local combo_interval = GetPassiveNumber(caster, "invoker_chaos_meteor_combo", "interval", 0.1) or 0.1
    local extra_volley = GetPassiveNumber(caster, "invoker_chaos_meteor_volley", "count", 0) or 0

    local sub_count = GetPassiveNumber(caster, "invoker_chaos_meteor_sub", "count", 0) or 0
    local fireball_base = GetPassiveAbility(caster, "invoker_chaos_meteor_fireball")
    local fire_active = GetPassiveAbility(caster, "invoker_chaos_meteor_fire") ~= nil
    LogEnhancePassives(caster, string.format(
        "combo=%s interval=%.2f volley=%s sub=%s fireball=%s fire=%s",
        tostring(extra_combo),
        tonumber(combo_interval) or 0,
        tostring(extra_volley),
        tostring(sub_count),
        tostring(fireball_base ~= nil),
        tostring(fire_active)
    ))

    if extra_volley > 0 and not skip_extras then
        local targets = SelectTargetsAround(owner, pos, range, extra_volley, params.target)
        if #targets > 0 then
            ability.__enhance_skip = (ability.__enhance_skip or 0) + #targets
            for i, enemy in ipairs(targets) do
                Timers:CreateTimer(0.02 * i, function()
                    if not ability or ability:IsNull() or not caster or caster:IsNull() then
                        return nil
                    end
                    ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                        UnitIndex = caster:entindex(),
                        OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
                        AbilityIndex = ability:entindex(),
                        Position = enemy:GetAbsOrigin(),
                        Queue = true,
                    })
                    return nil
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    if extra_combo > 0 and not skip_extras then
        ability.__enhance_skip = (ability.__enhance_skip or 0) + extra_combo
        for i = 1, extra_combo do
            Timers:CreateTimer(combo_interval * (i - 1), function()
                if not ability or ability:IsNull() or not caster or caster:IsNull() then
                    return nil
                end
                ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                    UnitIndex = caster:entindex(),
                    OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
                    AbilityIndex = ability:entindex(),
                    Position = pos,
                    Queue = true,
                })
                return nil
            end)
        end
    end

    if sub_count > 0 and not skip_extras then
        local land_time = tonumber(ability:GetSpecialValueFor("land_time") or 0) or 0
        local offset_range = GetPassiveNumber(caster, "invoker_chaos_meteor_sub", "offset_range", 250) or 250
        ability.__enhance_skip = (ability.__enhance_skip or 0) + sub_count
        Timers:CreateTimer(land_time, function()
            if not ability or ability:IsNull() or not caster or caster:IsNull() then
                return nil
            end
            SetMeteorLandTimeOverride(caster, 0)
            local search_range = math.max(0, offset_range)
            local targets = SelectTargetsAround(owner, pos, search_range, sub_count, nil)
            local base_dir = pos - caster:GetAbsOrigin()
            base_dir.z = 0
            if base_dir:Length2D() < 0.01 and caster.GetForwardVector then
                base_dir = caster:GetForwardVector()
                base_dir.z = 0
            end
            if base_dir:Length2D() < 0.01 then
                base_dir = Vector(1, 0, 0)
            end
            base_dir = base_dir:Normalized()

            for i = 1, sub_count do
                local target = targets[i]
                local target_pos = nil
                if target and not target:IsNull() then
                    target_pos = target:GetAbsOrigin()
                else
                    local rot = RandomFloat(-30, 30)
                    local dir = RotateDirection2D(base_dir, rot)
                    target_pos = pos + dir:Normalized() * offset_range
                end
                ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                    UnitIndex = caster:entindex(),
                    OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
                    AbilityIndex = ability:entindex(),
                    Position = target_pos,
                    Queue = true,
                })
            end
            Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
                if caster and not caster:IsNull() then
                    SetMeteorLandTimeOverride(caster, false)
                end
                return nil
            end)
            return nil
        end)
    end

    fireball_base = fireball_base or GetPassiveAbility(caster, "invoker_chaos_meteor_fireball")
    if fireball_base then
        local land_time = tonumber(ability:GetSpecialValueFor("land_time") or 0) or 0
        local count = GetPassiveNumber(caster, "invoker_chaos_meteor_fireball", "count", 2) or 2
        local count_bonus = GetPassiveNumber(caster, "invoker_chaos_meteor_fireball_combo", "count", 0) or 0
        local total = math.max(0, count + count_bonus)
        local search_range = GetPassiveNumber(caster, "invoker_chaos_meteor_fireball", "search_range", 600) or 600
        local radius = GetPassiveNumber(caster, "invoker_chaos_meteor_fireball", "radius", 250) or 250
        local speed = GetPassiveNumber(caster, "invoker_chaos_meteor_fireball", "speed", 900) or 900
        local base_damage = GetPassiveNumber(caster, "invoker_chaos_meteor_fireball", "base_damage", 0) or 0
        local base_scale = GetPassiveNumber(caster, "invoker_chaos_meteor_fireball", "damage_scale", 1) or 1
        LogEnhancePassives(caster, string.format(
            "fireball total=%s range=%s radius=%s speed=%s base=%s scale=%s",
            tostring(total),
            tostring(search_range),
            tostring(radius),
            tostring(speed),
            tostring(base_damage),
            tostring(base_scale)
        ))

        local dmg_bonus = GetPassiveAbility(caster, "invoker_chaos_meteor_fireball_damage")
        if dmg_bonus then
            local raw = enhance_common.GetPassiveRawValue(dmg_bonus, "damage_scale")
            base_scale = enhance_common.ApplyFlatPctIncrement(base_scale, raw, dmg_bonus:GetLevel())
        end
        local dmg_range = GetPassiveAbility(caster, "invoker_chaos_meteor_fireball_damage_range")
        if dmg_range then
            local raw = enhance_common.GetPassiveRawValue(dmg_range, "damage_scale")
            base_scale = enhance_common.ApplyFlatPctIncrement(base_scale, raw, dmg_range:GetLevel())
            local radius_pct = GetPassiveNumber(caster, "invoker_chaos_meteor_fireball_damage_range",
                "radius_pct", 0) or 0
            radius = radius * (1 + radius_pct / 100)
        end

        Timers:CreateTimer(land_time, function()
            if total <= 0 then
                return nil
            end
            local targets = SelectTargetsAround(owner, pos, search_range, total, nil)
            local missing = total - #targets
            local release_list = {}
            if missing > 0 then
                local base_dir = pos - caster:GetAbsOrigin()
                base_dir.z = 0
                if base_dir:Length2D() < 0.01 and caster.GetForwardVector then
                    base_dir = caster:GetForwardVector()
                    base_dir.z = 0
                end
                if base_dir:Length2D() < 0.01 then
                    base_dir = Vector(1, 0, 0)
                end
                base_dir = base_dir:Normalized()
                for i = 1, missing do
                    local rot = RandomFloat(-30, 30)
                    local dir = RotateDirection2D(base_dir, rot):Normalized()
                    local dummy = enhance_common.AcquireTrackingTarget(owner:GetTeamNumber())
                    if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
                        dummy:SetAbsOrigin(pos + dir * search_range)
                        if dummy.SetForwardVector then
                            dummy:SetForwardVector(dir)
                        end
                        table.insert(targets, dummy)
                        table.insert(release_list, { dummy = dummy })
                    end
                end
            end
            local ability_for_projectile = fireball_base
            if not ability_for_projectile then
                ability_for_projectile = GetPassiveAbility(caster, "invoker_chaos_meteor_fireball_combo")
            end
            if not ability_for_projectile then
                ability_for_projectile = GetPassiveAbility(caster, "invoker_chaos_meteor_fireball_damage")
            end
            if not ability_for_projectile then
                ability_for_projectile = GetPassiveAbility(caster,
                    "invoker_chaos_meteor_fireball_damage_range")
            end
            for _, enemy in ipairs(targets) do
                LaunchFireball(ability_for_projectile or fireball_base, owner, enemy, {
                    owner_entindex = owner:entindex(),
                    base_damage = base_damage,
                    damage_scale = base_scale,
                    radius = radius,
                    speed = speed,
                    source_pos = pos,
                    pure_percent = profile and profile.pure_percent or 0,
                })
            end
            if #release_list > 0 then
                for _, entry in ipairs(release_list) do
                    local dummy = entry.dummy
                    if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
                        local travel = search_range / math.max(speed, 1)
                        Timers:CreateTimer(travel + 0.2, function()
                            enhance_common.ReleaseTrackingTarget(dummy)
                            return nil
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
            return nil
        end)
    end

    if GetPassiveAbility(caster, "invoker_chaos_meteor_fire") then

The requirement implies sub meteors should be visual-only particles rolling from impact points, but actual damage requires casting abilities that create falling meteor visuals too; resolving this means either simulating damage along particle paths or overriding ability particles to keep damage while matching visuals, with trade-offs on complexity.

Profile fields like base_damage, damage_scale, and pure_percent will drive sub damage, using the existing dummy autocast profile.
